# Models and languages

Every model in the catalog (74 of them), what it speaks, and which models cover a given language. Generated from `app/catalog.py`, so it always matches the catalog the gateway actually ships.

The WebUI Models tab shows the same information per card, with a language filter. Use this page to pick a model before installing anything.

- [Models by engine](#models-by-engine)
- [Language sets](#language-sets)
- [Language index](#language-index)

## Reading the flags

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `streaming` | Decodes incrementally over a WebSocket while you speak |
| `auto language` | The model picks the language itself. The language chosen in the app **cannot** constrain it, so the listed languages are what it handles well, not options you select |
| `Apple silicon` | Needs an arm64 Mac; hidden on Linux and in containers |
| `personal use` | Licence restricts commercial use — check before deploying |
